mutation: PostgresAgentMetrics.drift() compared the stored source_digest column instead of recomputing the digest from the stored row's own values, so a projection whose counts were edited without touching the digest column read as faithful.
performedBy: manual mutation during the metrics projection milestone. This was not a hypothetical: the implementation shipped with exactly this defect and the integration test caught it before the observer was wired, which is why the mutation is the original code.
